text:
zara: Quick heads-up: spontaneous LAN & indie showcase next Thu 7pm in mezz. Bring controllers, Steam keys, and comfy socks.
owen: I'm in. I'll bring a spare router + ethernet cables. :nerd_face:
lina: I can bring my Deck and a couple of co-op indie titles (Spiritfarer-lite demo idea). Also a portable battery.
brad: I'll bring Smash + adapters. Also can throw in a small mic for funny commentary.
zara: Love the idea of short indie demos between Smash matches. Maybe 15min spotlight slots?
own: yes — people can sign up for a 15min demo slot, and a quick Q&A after.
lina: Also, does anyone have a USB ethernet adapter for my Deck? My dock is packed.
brad: I have one. Marking it 'brad - USB NIC' on the gear table.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please follow guest and storage policies: https://intranet.redwood/visitors and label personal gear.
zara: Tentative run sheet:
```
19:00 - doors & quick setup
19:20 - indie spotlights (3x15min)
20:10 - Smash/social matches
21:30 - speedrun/showcase micro-sets
22:00 - teardown
```
own: Also poll — should we stream? :camera: or keep it offline?
lina: Offline preferred for low-lag local vibe. Could stream highlights later.
brad: Offline sounds good. Less pressure. :relieved:
zara: OK offline. If anyone wants to demo online, share clips later. I'll post a signup Google Sheet Monday.
own: Who's bringing snacks? I'm up for chips.
lina: I'll bring cookies.
brad: I'll bring energy drink assortment (responsibly).
zara: Awesome. If you're bringing a guest, please mention here. See y'all Thursday! :joystick:
